basic_info.description: Edwardian home that has a distinctive farmhouse style with architectural features including large windows, a covered front porch and a spacious layout. This four-bedroom, three-bath home in a central Inner Sunset location features two spacious levels which blend traditional aesthetics with modern conveniences. The light filled living room has an open layout that connects to a formal dining room. The remodeled kitchen opens to the great room, offering a view of the garden and is enhanced by a large skylight. The kitchen includes quartz counters with glass tile backsplash, stainless appliances, and quality cabinets including a pantry. Completing the main level is a bedroom with an office and a full bath with a clawfoot tub. The ground-level features a family room, laundry closet, three well-appointed bedrooms and two remodeled bathrooms. Rear bedrooms access a deep yard with a patio and artificial lawn. This home has a 1-car garage and is within walking distance of shops and eateries.
